prompt: Why should a ref not be written while rendering, apart from a throwaway counter?

prompt: Before the fix, where did Tab land after "Statistics" was pressed?

prompt: Why does the course heading carry `tabIndex={-1}`?

choices.why: A ref works on any element.

choices.text: Focus from code, not from Tab
To hide it from screen readers
choices.why: It is announced when focused, which is the point.

prompt: A screen-reader user opens a course. Before the fix, what did they hear?

choices.text: "Statistics, heading level 1"
